_comment: Larger Dreamer/DMC set built to make drift measurable: 10 scenarios x 7 horizons (70 rollouts) instead of 3 x 4. A single scenario's fitted drift rate is mostly noise (a first real run gave -0.006, +0.001, +0.005 per second), so drift is read off the mean across scenarios and its standard error (reporting.drift_stats). More horizons give each scenario's score-vs-horizon fit more points; horizons of one scenario are nested prefixes of the same trajectory, so the extra ones are cheap. Same constraints as dreamer_dmc_set.json: a DMC episode is 500 agent steps (~25 s at 20 steps/s), so 20 s + 5 context steps is the practical maximum; `prompt` is only a label; `seed` fixes the simulator start, action sequence, and latent sampling. A separate file (not an edit) so results and baselines made with the 3-seed set stay comparable. Run with: python scripts/run_dreamer.py --standard-set worldoptbench/prompts/dreamer_dmc_set_10seeds.json ...
